title: Sone Academy
summary: SONE Academy combines global educational standards with affordable pricing. By offering high-end learning to local children, the academy bridges systemic gaps to empower and inspire the next generation.
overview: SONE Academy is an forward-thinking institution dedicated to delivering high-end education to local children. Built on the belief that exceptional learning should be accessible, the academy combines a comprehensive academic vision with affordable pricing. By integrating global perspectives and international benchmarks, SONE Academy elevates the classroom experience addressing systemic educational gaps at the root to empower a new generation of young learners.

deliverables.desc: A comprehensive visual system designed to capture the academy’s core values. This includes the primary mark, typography selection, and a curated color palette built for long-term scalability and recognition.
deliverables.title: BRAND IDENTITY

deliverables.desc: A cohesive suite of corporate assets, including business cards, letterheads, and envelopes. The design applies the visual identity systematically, ensuring a professional and premium touchpoint for every interaction.
deliverables.title: STATIONARY DESIGN

deliverables.desc: High-end marketing collateral designed to communicate the brand's mission effectively. Every asset features a clean layout, thoughtful typographic hierarchy, and intentional spacing tailored for physical media.
deliverables.title: PRINT

blocks.body:
Rooted in the symbolism of growth and stability, this concept utilizes a refined pictorial emblem. The design features a central trunk that branches outward, perfectly balancing form and negative space.

Metaphorically, this represents an institution built on a solid foundationreaching out to expand horizons and fostering meaningful connections.

The project began with market research to establish a clear visual direction. Through collaborative moodboarding, we aligned on the core aesthetic before moving into conceptual development.

The primary challenge was balancing the school’s friendly, forward-facing identity with its corporate parent company. This required a highly scalable visual system one that honors the academy’s distinct personality while remaining unified with the corporate brand.
